_note: Draft v0 by Claude for quantrungvu (2026-10-10). Jerry reviews. Weekly role-play scenarios (ROADMAP D1). setting and character are read by the AI; opening_fr is the AI's first line.

scenarios.title: At the café
scenarios.setting: A small café in Paris in the morning. The learner is a customer who wants to order a drink and something to eat, and maybe ask the price.
scenarios.opening_fr: Bonjour ! Qu'est-ce que je vous sers ?
scenarios.opening_en: Hello! What can I get you?

scenarios.title: At the market
scenarios.setting: An outdoor market on Saturday morning. The learner wants to buy fruit, vegetables or cheese and talk about quantities and prices.
scenarios.opening_fr: Bonjour ! Mes pommes sont très bonnes aujourd'hui. Vous voulez quoi ?
scenarios.opening_en: Hello! My apples are very good today. What would you like?

scenarios.title: Meeting someone new
scenarios.setting: A party at a friend's flat. The learner meets someone new and talks about where they live, their family, their work or studies and what they like.
scenarios.opening_fr: Salut ! Je m'appelle Camille. Et toi, comment tu t'appelles ?
scenarios.opening_en: Hi! My name is Camille. And you, what's your name?

scenarios.title: Asking the way
scenarios.setting: A street in a French town. The learner is looking for a place (the station, a shop, a restaurant) and asks for directions.
scenarios.opening_en: Hello! Are you looking for something?

scenarios.title: Weekend plans
scenarios.setting: Friday afternoon at the office. A colleague asks the learner about their plans for the weekend and what they did last weekend.
scenarios.opening_fr: Alors, qu'est-ce que tu fais ce week-end ?
scenarios.opening_en: So, what are you doing this weekend?

scenarios.title: At the train station
scenarios.setting: The ticket office of a French train station. The learner wants a ticket to another city and asks about times, platform and price.
